Patrols the living world by night and se: Patrols the living world by night and seizes wandering souls (docs/01 fifth layer; docs/02 §6) - the arrest side of the underworld, with The Impermanences
The Meng Po - keeps the 醧忘台 at the tenth: Meng Po - keeps the Terrace of Forgetting at the tenth court, beyond the six bridges before the king's hall, and serves the broth of forgetting to souls already sentenced and bound for the next life
Patrols the living world by day and reco: Patrols the living world by day and records good and evil (docs/01 fifth layer; docs/02 §6). CONDUIT with The Impermanences as the least-wrong role: ActorRole has no term for patrol-and-record
White Impermanence (七爷 谢必安) - captures w: White Impermanence (Seventh Master, Xie Bi'an) - captures wandering souls, brings gentle death
Black Impermanence (八爷 范无救) - captures w: Black Impermanence (Eighth Master, Fan Wujiu) - captures wicked souls with chains of darkness
Demon queller - hunts malignant ghosts a: Demon queller - hunts malignant ghosts and wards the household (Shen Kuo, Dream Pool Essays, Supplement, juan 3; the Dunhuang New Year's Eve exorcism text on Zhong Kui). NOT A JADE RECORDS FIGURE: he appears nowhere in that text and holds no office in the ten courts. His pairing with the Bureau of Punishing Evil of the Four Great Registrars is a late popular attribution, and this row is filed at the fifth court for want of a posting, not on a source
Puts the cangue and chains on the dead s: Puts the cangue and chains on the dead so they cannot escape; has charge of the gravest offenders (docs/01 fifth layer; docs/02 §6). Custody rather than punishment, so GUARDIAN with Ox Head and Horse Face
Ox Head - one of the two guardians who e: Ox Head - one of the two guardians who escort the dead. The Jade Records names the pair at the fifth court, marching the condemned up the Terrace for Viewing Home; the escort itself runs across all ten courts
Ghost Emperor of the East - holds 鬼门关 on: Ghost Emperor of the East - holds the Ghost Gate on Mount Taozhi and drives out malignant ghosts; with Yulei one of the two ancient door gods who bind ghosts with reed rope (docs/02 §2, which gives the Classic of Mountains and Seas as the earliest record). The Ghost Gate is not modelled; filed at the holding pen, the nearest place before the first court
地藏王菩萨's mount - discerns true from false: Ksitigarbha's mount - discerns true from false in a soul's testimony and helps deliver the dead; white, between dog and lion in form (docs/02 §1). A subordinate, not a deity in its own right, and a figure of Chinese folk tradition and Journey to the West, not of Buddhist scripture - the docs say so. Filed with Ksitigarbha at the intake court. GUARDIAN is the least-wrong role: it decides nothing
Ghost Emperor of the East - keeps 鬼门关 to: Ghost Emperor of the East - keeps the Ghost Gate together with Shentu; the east is the one quarter with two emperors (docs/01 second layer; docs/02 §2). Placement as for Shentu
Horse Face - companion guardian of the u: Horse Face - companion guardian of the underworld dead; see Ox Head for the fifth-court escort to the Terrace for Viewing Home that the Jade Records names them in
Fourth court judge - presides over 合大地狱:: Fourth court judge - presides over the Great Crushing Hell: withholding grain tax and rent, fraud in trade
Sixth court judge - presides over 大叫唤大地狱: Sixth court judge - presides over the Greater Howling Hell: sacrilege against images and scriptures, irreverence toward heaven and earth
Third court judge - presides over 黑绳大地狱:: Third court judge - presides over the Great Black Rope Hell: defying one's elders, inciting litigation, betraying a trust
Ninth court judge - presides over 阿鼻大地狱,: Ninth court judge - presides over Avici Hell, the deepest hell: murder, arson, poisoning, the gravest crimes
Second court judge - presides over 活大地狱,: Second court judge - presides over the Great Reviving Hell, the mildest punishment court: abduction, appropriating what belongs to others, maiming
Seventh court judge - presides over 热恼大地: Seventh court judge - presides over the Great Burning Hell: taking bones for medicine, and the scattering of kin from one another
Eighth court judge - presides over 大热恼大地: Eighth court judge - presides over the Greater Burning Hell: unfilial conduct, the parent left unkept in life and unburied in death. Dushi here is the capital, not a marketplace
北阴大帝 - head of the whole underworld from: Great Emperor of the Northern Yin - head of the whole underworld from Mount Luofeng (the city of Fengdu), superior of the ten kings in the Daoist pantheon; hears the last instance of an appeal
Fifth court judge - the best-known of th: Fifth court judge - the best-known of the ten kings. He sat at the first court and was demoted here for leniency, by his own account: out of pity for the wrongly dead he kept sending them back to life to clear their names, and was reassigned to the Howling Hell and its sixteen small hells of the heart. His court tries the intent behind the act, and the Terrace for Viewing Home stands in it
Underworld judge of 《聊斋志异·陆判》, where the: Underworld judge of "Judge Lu" in Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio, where the text calls him only Judge Lu or Lord Lu (the name Lu Zhidao is a later folk addition). Popular lists of the Four Great Registrars give him the Bureau of Underworld Law, revising the underworld's laws - an office with no source, absent from the City God's twenty-four bureaus (docs/02 §4)
Head of the 察查司 - audits wrongful convic: Head of the Bureau of Inquiry - audits wrongful convictions and overturns a king's misjudgment; the opening node of the Chinese appeal workflow. Bureau of Inquiry is this system's term, not a classical office: Wei Zheng appears in the underworld narrative of Journey to the West ch. 10 as a living chancellor writing to Cui Jue, not as a seated judge, and the popular four-registrar lists that do place him usually give him the Bureau of Rewarding Good instead
泰山神 - holds authority over the birth of: God of Mount Tai - holds authority over the birth of all things and protects the souls going round the wheel of rebirth; very high in popular cult (docs/01 first layer; docs/02 §1.3). NOT King Taishan: the seventh court's king is a different seat, and that row's own note records that the Jade Records does not give the seventh court Mount Tai. REALM IS A COMPROMISE: Mount Tai is not a modelled realm
后土皇地祇 - source of both the living and th: Sovereign Earth Goddess - source of both the living and the dead, keeper of birth, death and rebirth, of the earth and the underworld; one of the Four Sovereigns of Daoism, called Mother Earth and held to be the underworld's founder (docs/01 first layer; docs/02 §1.1). Above the Emperor of Fengdu and the Emperor of the Eastern Peak in the docs' ordering. REALM IS A COMPROMISE: she has no seat this system models, so she is filed at the intake court beside Ksitigarbha and the Emperor of Fengdu
Ghost Emperor of the Centre - on 抱犊山, co: Ghost Emperor of the Centre - on Mount Baodu, coordinates the other four quarters and keeps the balance of yin and yang (docs/02 §2). The docs record few sources for this seat and call its holder's name disputed. Mount Baodu is not modelled; filed at the holding pen
Bodhisattva of the Great Vow - 地狱不空，誓不成佛: Bodhisattva of the Great Vow, who will not become a Buddha until the hells are empty. Delivers souls out of the hells; relief path for wrongful deaths and those in the torture chambers
Ghost Emperor of the North - sits at 罗酆山: Ghost Emperor of the North - sits at Mount Luofeng in Fengdu and keeps the underworld's punishments (docs/02 §2). The seat has a second candidate, Yang Yun; the docs list both. Mount Luofeng is not modelled; filed at the holding pen
Ghost Emperor of the South - governs the: Ghost Emperor of the South - governs the southern ghost domain from Mount Luofu and subdues violent souls (docs/02 §2). Mount Luofu is not modelled; filed at the holding pen
Ghost Emperor of the West - governs the: Ghost Emperor of the West - governs the western ghost domain from Mount Bozhong (docs/02 §2). The seat has a second candidate, Wang Zhenren; the docs list both. Mount Bozhong is not modelled; filed at the holding pen
Souls awaiting reunion with loved ones. SOURCE UNKNOWN: no underworld place by this name appears in the Jade Records or the Scripture of the Ten Kings; treat as this project's own element until a source is produced
Intake court - the Ledger of Life and De: Intake court - the Ledger of Life and Death is read and the soul's case opened at the Mirror of Retribution; no punishment is administered here
活大地狱 - the mildest punishment court; thi: Great Reviving Hell - the mildest punishment court; thieves and those who wounded others in life
黑绳大地狱 - 忤逆尊长, 教唆兴讼, 背恩失节: defying one's: Great Black Rope Hell - defying one's elders, inciting litigation, betraying a trust
合大地狱 - fraud, withheld dues, falsified a: Great Crushing Hell - fraud, withheld dues, falsified accounts
叫唤大地狱 and the 十六诛心小地狱 - the court that t: The Howling Hell and its sixteen small hells of the heart - the court that tries the intent behind the act: malice, ingratitude, envy, miserliness. The Terrace for Viewing Home stands here
大叫唤大地狱 - sacrilege and irreverence: Greater Howling Hell - sacrilege and irreverence
热恼大地狱 - taking bones for medicine, scatt: Great Burning Hell - taking bones for medicine, scattering of kin
大热恼大地狱 - unfilial conduct and betrayal o: Greater Burning Hell - unfilial conduct and betrayal of one's own house
阿鼻地狱 - the deepest hell; murder, arson,: Avici Hell - the deepest hell; murder, arson, the crimes with no remedy
